description: Review Markdown changes as rendered documents: word-level diffs in text, tables and Mermaid diagrams, side-by-side view, per-change "seen" tracking and git baselines.
untrusted: In Restricted Mode the extension does not run git and does not render raw HTML from Markdown files.
welcome.untrusted:
Markdown Rendered Diff reads git history, which requires a trusted workspace.
[Manage Workspace Trust](command:workbench.trust.manage)
welcome.noRepo:
No git repository found in this workspace (or one folder below it).
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
You can still open a Markdown file inside a repository and run "Open Rendered Diff".
cfg.defaultBaseline: Baseline used until you pick another one from the sidebar.
cfg.b.head: Last commit (HEAD): all uncommitted changes
cfg.b.reviewed: Since you last marked each file as viewed
cfg.b.claude: Latest Claude Code turn (needs turn tracking enabled)
cfg.b.mergeBase: As in the pull/merge request (merge base with the target branch)
cfg.mrBaseBranch: Target branch of your pull/merge request, used by the "As in the PR/MR" baseline. Leave empty to detect it (origin/HEAD, then main, master, develop).
cfg.renderHtml: Render raw HTML inside Markdown (e.g. HTML tables). Always off in Restricted Mode.
cfg.allowRemoteImages: Load images from http(s) URLs in the Review tab. Off by default so opening a document never contacts external servers.
